kv17.10:0.4: 17. 10. na vattabbaṃ buddhassa dinnaṃ mahapphalanti kathā.
kv17.10:1.4: nanu bhagavā dvipadānaṃ. aggo, dvipadānaṃ seṭṭho, dvipadānaṃ pamokkho, dvipadānaṃ uttamo, dvipādānaṃ pararo, asamo asamasamo appaṭisamo appaṭibhāgo appaṭipuggalo’ti.
kv17.10:1.6: hañci bhagavā dvipadānaṃ. aggo, dvipadānaṃ seṭṭho, dvipadānaṃ pamokkho, dvipadānaṃ uttamo, dvipadānaṃ pavaro, asamo asamasameṃ appaṭisamo appaṭibhāgo appaṭipuggalo, tena vata re vattabbe
kv17.10:2.8: sīlena samādhinā paññāya, tena vana re vattabbe
kv17.10:4.2: buddhena seṭṭho ca samo ca vijjati
kv17.10:5.4: na vattabbaṃ buddhassa dinnaṃ mahapphalanti kathā niṭṭhitā.
